item.title: Greg Moore: Practical biblical applications when your children start dating [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

This week was a family episode! Just Greg and the Dead Heads! Greg discussed his journey having two teen age daughters, what that looks like as they start to notice others of the opposite sex, practical ""best practices" that he has used, as well as biblical foundation for how to treat possible future in-laws. If you have children at any stage of life, or thinking about filling your quiver, this will be a great episode for you. Enjoy!
